user_reported_bug: User feedback (19 Aug 2026): 'RTO corrected but DTO - No change after re calculation also'. The DTO backend values were already correct per Google Doc Point 2.1 (commission negative, fixed_fee zero, GT negative, return_fee positive), but the UI was hard-coding all fee cells to red (fin-neg) regardless of sign — so DTO reversals (negative commission = credit) looked identical to charges. User perceived 'no change'. Fix: colour classes are now VALUE-DRIVEN — positive = red (charge/cost), negative = green (reversal/credit), zero = neutral.
